issues.description: The Bitmap24 API visibility is inconsistent: the template version declares Bitmap24::save(...) and Bitmap24::set(...) as private, but main.cpp calls bitmap.save(...) (public use). The solution repository declares these methods as public. With the template header marking them private, students will get access-control compilation errors and be blocked from building/running the provided example program.
issues.suggestedFix: Make Bitmap24::save(...) and Bitmap24::set(...) public in the template header (move their declarations into the public section) so that example_program/src/main.cpp can call bitmap.save(...) as intended. This matches the solution and preserves the educational intent while ensuring the project compiles.
